validation.batch: Enter the batch number from the pack.
validation.expires: Enter the expiry date from the pack.

errors.insufficient_stock: There is not enough stock left to write off.

lots.title: Stock by lot
lots.description: Every lot with stock at your locations, earliest expiry first.
lots.empty: No stock by lot yet. Receive stock to start.

lot.notFound: This lot does not exist, or you cannot see it.
lot.recalled: This batch is under a recall
lot.recalledHelp: It cannot be sold, moved or released until the recall is lifted.
lot.expiredHelp: This lot has expired. It cannot be sold or moved. Write it off when you are ready.
lot.quarantineHelp: A quarantined lot cannot be sold or moved at any location until it is released.
lot.releaseHelp: The lot can be sold again if it has not expired.

receive.title: Receive stock
receive.help: Record the batch, expiry and cost from the pack and the delivery note. Inventory is told what arrived.
receive.referenceHelp: Optional. Printed on the supplier's note.

move.title: Move stock
move.help: Move lots between two locations of the same company. Lots leave the source first expiry first.
move.shortfall: Only part is in stock: {{qty}} short.

writeOffs.title: Write-offs
writeOffs.description: Expired, damaged or recalled stock leaves the books when a branch manager approves.
writeOffs.newHelp: Choose the lots and quantities. Stock leaves when the request is approved.

writeOff.notFound: This write-off does not exist, or you cannot see it.
writeOff.cancelHelp: Nothing leaves stock. The request is closed.
writeOff.failed: This write-off could not be posted
writeOff.failedHelp: Stock changed after it was requested. Make a new request.

flow.title: Approval
flow.nobody: Nobody can act on this step yet.

recalls.title: Recalls
recalls.description: A recall blocks one batch at every location and till at once.
recalls.issueHelp: Every lot of this item and batch number is blocked everywhere. Nobody can sell it until you lift the recall.
recalls.referenceHelp: Optional. The notice number, as the regulator wrote it.

recall.notFound: This recall does not exist, or you cannot see it.
recall.customersHelp: Customers named on sales of this batch, less what was refunded or voided.
recall.noCustomers: No named customer bought this batch.
recall.unattributed_one: {{count}} sale ({{qty}} units) had no named customer.
recall.unattributed_other: {{count}} sales ({{qty}} units) had no named customer.
recall.liftHelp: The lots can be sold again, unless they are quarantined or expired.

prescriptions.title: Prescriptions
prescriptions.description: Patient and prescriber records. Personal data: only those who need it can open them.
prescriptions.search: Search by patient, prescriber, licence or facility
prescriptions.licenceHelp: As the prescriber's regulator wrote it.

prescription.notFound: This prescription does not exist, or you cannot see it.
prescription.imageHelp: A photo or scan of the prescription. Optional.
prescription.cancelHelp: It stays on file but can no longer be used.

register.title: Controlled-drug register
register.description: Every receipt, dispense, return, transfer and write-off of a controlled item at one location, with its running balance.
register.pick: Choose an item and a location to print or correct the register.
register.search: Search by batch, patient or prescriber
register.correctHelp: The register is never edited. A correction is a new entry with a reason.
register.correctQtyHelp: Use a minus sign to remove, for example -2.

dispenses.title: Dispenses to review
dispenses.description: Sales the server kept but found something to check: an expired batch, a missing prescription, an unproven approval.
dispenses.logDescription: Items dispensed against a prescription, with the prescriber, the patient and the pharmacist.
dispenses.search: Search by receipt, patient or prescriber
dispenses.logEmpty: Nothing was dispensed against a prescription yet.
dispenses.reviewHelp: Say what you checked. The note is kept with the sale.

expiry.title: Expiry report
expiry.description: Lots with stock that expired or expire soon.

slow.title: Slow movers per batch
slow.description: Lots with stock that did not sell where they are held.
slow.empty: No lot has gone this long without a sale.

items.title: Item profiles
items.description: Which items are medicines, controlled, poisons or agrochemicals, and how the pharmacy handles each.
items.empty: No item has a pharmacy profile yet.
items.usageNotesHelp: Shown at the till when the item is added.
items.scheduleNoteHelp: In the regulator's words. Not checked here; to confirm.
items.withdrawalDaysHelp: For veterinary and agrochemical items. Optional.

settings.title: Pharmacy settings
settings.toConfirm: These values are the pharmacy's own choices. Confirm them against the rules you work under: none is taken from a regulator.
settings.nearExpiryDaysHelp: Lots closer to expiry than this warn at the till and appear in alerts.
settings.minSaleDays: Least days to expiry to sell
settings.minSaleDaysHelp: A lot closer to expiry than this is refused at the till. 0 refuses only expired stock.
settings.prescriptionClassesHelp: A sale of these needs a prescription on the sale.
settings.pharmacistClassesHelp: A sale of these needs a pharmacist's approval at the till.
settings.validDaysHelp: Leave empty to not check the age of a prescription.
